basics.name: Lyutianyang Zhang
basics.label: Assistant Professor, Chongqing University
basics.summary: Assistant Professor at Chongqing University working on intelligent wireless communication system cross-layer optimization, Wi-Fi 8 standardization, B5G/6G, ISAC, deep learning-based channel access, and PHY-MAC resource allocation.

work.summary: Intelligent wireless communication system cross-layer optimization for Wi-Fi, B5G/6G, ISAC, and Wi-Fi 8 standardization.
Proposed new Wi-Fi technologies for IEEE 802.11bn PHY and MAC standardization.
highlights: IEEE Wi-Fi 8 standardization working group voter and contributor.
Held 5 first-author Wi-Fi 8 technology patents and 1 first-author IEEE Wi-Fi 8 TGbn standard proposal.
Honors: Star of Tomorrow and Excellent Employee.

work.summary: Implemented iPhone DL/UL rate adaptation performance evaluation, wireless test setup, data analysis, and PHY/MAC performance debugging.
highlights: Managed RF shield-box RvR testing with fader, attenuator, NED, and FF equipment.
Proposed link-adaptation and medium-utilization algorithm tuning for product performance enhancement.

work.summary: Integrated 5G core network, baseband unit, active antenna unit, and user equipment.
highlights: Used QXDM/QCAT for chip-level data collection and performance analysis.
Used UERANSIM to emulate end-to-end 5G core scenarios.

work.summary: Studied railway communication coexistence issues including power coexistence, Doppler effect, and power leakage.
highlights: Explored dynamic spectrum sharing using optimization, CNN, and deep reinforcement learning.

work.summary: Implemented neural-network-based end-to-end text-to-speech with Mel-spectrogram generation and vocoder synthesis.
